purpose: Pre-data economic margin hurdle only; never a claim of alpha and never a substitute for P3 development feasibility.
development_justification: A multi-day carry/unwind architecture is only worth development if its signal-conditioned move distribution can clear realistic round-trip costs by a material margin. The 2.5x value is intentionally stricter than break-even and remains falsifiable; it was not selected by inspecting BU-RC-002 holdout outcomes.
development_requirements: forward move median, MFE, MAE and gross expectancy
failure_rule: If development-only evidence cannot justify the design prior and clear the existing SSOT feasibility gate, P2/P3 remain HOLD and no fresh boundary is allowed.
